pillars.name: Governance
pillars.summary: Roles, decision rights and policies for how your company uses AI.

pillars.name: Risk management
pillars.summary: Identify, assess and reduce AI, data and vendor risks, with countermeasures on record.

pillars.name: Compliance
pillars.summary: Know your obligations and prove you meet them: audit-ready documentation, not binders.

not_included: Detailed risk assessment (see AI risk assessment)
packages.name: AI governance quick check
packages.outcome: In one day: what AI you use today, your five biggest risks, and where to start.
includes: Interview with your management (half day)
Snapshot of the AI tools and systems in use
Memo: your five biggest AI risks and the first steps
packages.price_note: Fully credited if you order a follow-on package within 3 months.

not_included: Legal review of the policy; we work alongside your lawyer
packages.name: AI policy & literacy
packages.outcome: A written AI policy your staff can follow, and a training that supports their AI literacy (EU AI Act Art. 4).
includes: Kickoff workshop
AI policy and acceptable-use rules
Approval workflow for new AI tools
Half-day in-house AI literacy session
Record of who was trained, and when

not_included: Unused days do not carry over
packages.name: AI governance retainer
packages.outcome: An external AI governance lead on call: one day a month for reviews, questions, vendor checks and incidents.
includes: One consulting day per month
Review of new AI tools and vendors
Help with AI incidents and questions from auditors
Short monthly status note

not_included: Technical security testing of the systems
packages.name: AI risk assessment
packages.outcome: A prioritised view of your AI risks with a mitigation plan, and a risk register your team keeps using.
includes: Inventory of the AI systems in scope
Risk workshops with the owners
Prioritised risk report with mitigation plan
Risk register in your own tools, with owners and review dates

not_included: Legal advice; we work alongside your lawyer
packages.name: EU AI Act readiness
packages.outcome: Know which obligations apply to you and what to do about them in the next 12 months.
includes: Inventory of your AI systems, with an owner for each
Classification under the EU AI Act
Gap analysis against the obligations that apply
12-month roadmap

packages.name: ISO/IEC 42001 gap assessment
packages.outcome: A clause-by-clause view of where you stand against ISO/IEC 42001.
includes: Document review
Interviews
Gap report with priorities
packages.price_note: For companies with ISO/IEC 27001 in place. Without it: €12,900.

not_included: Implementation (available as a project on request)
packages.name: Data & AI architecture review
packages.outcome: A clear review of your data and AI setup on Google Cloud, with a plan for what to build next.
includes: Workshops with your data and IT team
Review of your current data and AI architecture
Risks, costs and quick wins
Target architecture and roadmap
